glance.question: How do Christ's divine and human natures fit together in one person?

positions.name: Classical Christology
positions.claim: One person, two complete natures, united without confusion or separation.

positions.name: Kenotic Christology
positions.claim: The Son limited the use of his divine powers to live a fully human life.

positions.name: Lutheran Christology
positions.claim: Christ's human nature truly shares divine majesty, present as man as well as God.

start_here.title: Kenosis: The Self-Emptying of Christ in Scripture and Theology
start_here.author: Thomas Haviland-Pabst
start_here.why: A Reformed review of a scholarly volume on what Christ's self-emptying in Philippians 2 does and does not mean.

start_here.title: Recent trends in Christology
start_here.author: Gerald Bray
start_here.why: Bray surveys the scholarly answer to The Myth of God Incarnate and what it means for orthodox belief.

key_number.text: In 2022, 73% of Americans with evangelical beliefs agreed that Jesus is the first and greatest being created by God, a claim the Nicene Creed rejects.
